title: 第2172章 玄兵出鞘第2171章 黑甲降临
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
那身影没有完整的五官，只有一个模糊的轮廓。
那轮廓像是一个人形的影子，被压缩在一柄短刀的刀身上，在经历了无数岁月的消磨后，已经残破不堪。
但那轮廓上，有一双猩红色的眼睛。
那双眼睛此刻充满了难以言喻的情绪。
有愤怒。
那愤怒是在漫长岁月中被封印、被镇压、被消磨的不甘。
他是渊寂战祖，是曾经与兵主抗衡的存在，如今却沦落到被一柄短刀束缚、被一个降临者当众羞辱的地步。
有恐惧。
他认识这个人。
这个人来自万兵之洲。
有不甘。
他不该是这样的。
他应该已经重聚了九柄封印之兵中的力量，应该已经复苏了大半的实力，应该已经开始反攻了。
但那个继承了兵主传承的年轻人，打乱了他所有的计划。
还有一丝近乎哀求的意味。
不是哀求放过他。
是哀求不要彻底抹除他。
黑甲中年看着那道模糊的身影，没有说话。
他看了很久，像是在端详一件旧物，确认这件旧物还有没有修复的价值。
然后他开口。

声音不大，却像是惊雷一般，炸响在每一个旁观者的神魂深处。
那声音中蕴含的力量，让铁屠站在火山口边缘都觉得自己的神魂被震得发麻，像是有人在他的脑子里敲响了一口铜钟。
“渊寂战祖，被兵主打散之后，连一个像样的躯壳都凝聚不出来了？”
“还得依附在一柄破烂短刀上，靠着抽取九黎洲那些蝼蚁的本源苟延残喘？”
“你活得可真够难看的。”
他每说一个字，那道模糊的身影就黯淡一分。
仿佛他的话语本身，就带着某种无形的高位威压，在一点一点地消解着那道残魂的存在根基。
不是攻击，不是压制，是他站在那里说话这个事实本身，就在消解着渊寂战祖的存在。
渊寂战祖的残魂剧烈扭曲，模糊的轮廓上那些猩红色的纹路开始明灭不定。
他张了张嘴，似乎想说什么。
但黑甲中年没有给他说话的机会。
黑甲中年抬手，像驱赶一只烦人的苍蝇一样，随意地挥了一下。
content_en:
The figure had no complete facial features, only a vague outline.
The outline was like a human-shaped shadow, compressed on the body of a short sword. After countless years of wear and tear, it had become dilapidated.
But on that outline, there was a pair of scarlet eyes.
Those eyes were filled with indescribable emotions at the moment.
There is anger.
That anger is the unwillingness to be sealed, suppressed, and worn away over the long years.
He is the Yuanji War Ancestor, a being who once competed with the War Master, but now he has been reduced to being restrained by a short sword and humiliated in public by a descendant.
There is fear.
He knows this man.
This man comes from the Land of Ten Thousand Soldiers.
There is unwillingness.
He shouldn't be like this.
He should have reunited the strength of the Nine Seal Arms, should have recovered most of his strength, and should have started to counterattack.
But the young man who inherited the legacy of the military master disrupted all his plans.
There was also an almost pleading tone.
Not begging to let him go.
It’s a plea not to erase him completely.
The middle-aged man in black armor looked at the blurry figure and said nothing.
He looked at it for a long time, as if he was examining an old object to confirm whether it was still worth repairing.
Then he spoke.
The sound was not loud, but it was like thunder, exploding deep in the souls of every onlooker.
The power contained in that voice made Tie Tu feel as if his soul was numb from the shock even as he stood on the edge of the crater, as if someone was ringing a bell in his mind.
"Yuanji War Ancestor, after being scattered by the leader of the army, can't even form a decent body?"
"You still have to cling to a tattered short knife and rely on extracting the essence of those ants in Jiulizhou to survive?"
"You live a really ugly life."
Every time he said a word, the blurry figure dimmed a little.
It was as if his words themselves carried some kind of invisible high-level pressure, dissolving the foundation of the remnant soul's existence bit by bit.
It's not an attack, it's not a suppression. It's the fact that he is standing there talking that dissolves the existence of Yuanji Zhanzu.
The remnant soul of the Yuanji War Ancestor was violently distorted, and the scarlet lines on the blurry outline began to flicker.
He opened his mouth as if he wanted to say something.
But the middle-aged man in black armor didn't give him a chance to speak.
The middle-aged man in black armor raised his hand and waved it casually as if to ward off an annoying fly.
